description: Translates between one polyphonic cable carrying interleaved left and right channels and a pair of cables, one per side. Each side runs to eight channels

inputs.text: A polyphonic cable whose channels alternate between the left and the right side
The left side channels to be interleaved
The right side channels to be interleaved

outputs.text: The left side channels taken out of the interleaved cable
The right side channels taken out of the interleaved cable
One polyphonic cable carrying the two sides interleaved, a channel of one then a channel of the other
